title: Latency & Throughput
subtitle: Latency is what one request feels; throughput is what the system sustains
motto: Waiting time explodes long before capacity runs out
keyInsight: Latency is waiting time plus work time, and waiting time grows without bound as utilization approaches 100%.

decisions.title: Report p99 next to the average
decisions.description: Every frame shows the average and the p99 latency, so learners see the tail that an average hides.
decisions.alternatives: Showing only the average is simpler, but it repeats the exact mistake the chapter warns about.

decisions.title: One shared queue in front of the workers
decisions.description: A single queue with a pool of workers keeps the model to one formula while still showing the utilization cliff.
decisions.alternatives: A separate queue per worker or a bursty arrival process is closer to some real systems, but it hides the one relationship the chapter teaches.

decisions.title: Show batching at quiet-hour traffic
decisions.description: Batch fill time is worst when traffic is light, so the trade-off frame measures there to make the latency cost visible.
decisions.alternatives: Measuring at peak load makes batching look free, because batches fill instantly when traffic is heavy.
